payout_quote: For a limited time, you can receive a $300 bonus when you establish or increase qualifying payroll direct deposits into your Guardian checking account. Open a new Guardian checking account and establish recurring payroll direct deposits totaling at least $2,500 per month for two consecutive months.
payout_value_note: Flat $300 bonus for establishing or increasing qualifying payroll direct deposits ($2,500+/month for two consecutive months).
numeric_basis: payout from official myguardiancu.com terms (flat $300); time: account opening + DD setup 30-60 min active. Two-month DD maintenance is passive (not counted as active time).
steps: Open a new Guardian checking account (or use your existing Guardian checking account).
Establish or increase recurring payroll direct deposits totaling at least $2,500 per month.
Ensure your first qualifying payroll direct deposit is received by September 30, 2026.
Maintain $2,500+/month in qualifying payroll DD for two consecutive months.
catches: Requires $2,500/month in payroll direct deposits for two consecutive months - significant income routing.
First qualifying direct deposit must be received by September 30, 2026 (within 7 days).
Qualifying DD must be electronic payroll deposits from an employer; P2P transfers and other electronic deposits do not qualify.
Guardian Credit Union serves central Alabama (19 branches across 16 counties); membership eligibility required.
biggest_catch: Requires routing $2,500/month in payroll direct deposits for two consecutive months, and the first DD must land by September 30, 2026 - act fast.
eligibility: New Guardian members (open a new checking account) or existing members who establish/increase payroll DD. Central Alabama service area; membership eligibility required.
timing: First qualifying payroll direct deposit must be received by September 30, 2026. Maintain $2,500+/month for two consecutive months.
